created_prompt: I post cooking videos focusing on healthy recipes. I have 1.2M followers but I want to increase their number. I also want to publish a cookbook. Devise a three-year plan to help me reach these goals. The plan should be realistic and take into consideration that I work four days a week, so time is limited. Try also to keep the budget low. Provide two alternatives plans, one for publishing my cookbook through traditional publishing and for self-publishing.
